text: 中国央行公开市场开展1620亿元7天期逆回购操作，操作利率1.40%，持平上次。开展6000亿元隔夜逆回购操作。今日6030亿元逆回购到期。
text_en: The PBOC conducted 162 billion yuan in 7-day reverse repo operations in the open market at an operating rate of 1.40%, unchanged from the previous session. It also conducted 600 billion yuan in overnight reverse repo operations. Today, 603 billion yuan in reverse repos matured.
